summary: M3.S5 v2 — B2C private listings + admin moderation + M3.S4.1 smoke. Backend: 19/19 pytest PASS. Frontend Moderation page: PASS. Frontend B2C SellPage: BLOCKED by a backend bug — /api/auth/me does not return account_type, so SellPage redirects authenticated B2C users back to /cloud/register?intent=sell in a loop.

critical.issue: _public(user) in /app/backend/apps/core/auth.py does NOT serialize 'account_type' (nor 'intents'). Verified: keys returned are [id,email,name,role,lang,agency_ids,is_active,created_at,updated_at]. As a consequence, the frontend SellPage check `user.account_type !== 'b2c'` always evaluates true after page load and triggers an infinite redirect to /cloud/register?intent=sell. The B2C registration endpoint /api/cloud/auth/register DOES return account_type in its own response, but the AuthContext re-fetches /auth/me at boot, losing the field.

ui_bugs.issue: Cannot reach the page even after successful B2C login. Redirects to /cloud/register?intent=sell because user.account_type is undefined (root cause = backend bug above). All M3.S5 frontend tests for SellPage (#19–#23) are therefore blocked until /auth/me returns account_type.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: response serializer /app/backend/apps/core/auth.py::_public() omits B2C-only user fields (`account_type`, `intents`). The frontend AuthContext fetches /api/auth/me at app boot which strips the account_type that /api/cloud/auth/register did include in its own response. SellPage's effect `if (!user || user.account_type !== 'b2c') nav(.../register)` therefore fires for every authenticated B2C user. Fix: extend _public() to forward `account_type` and `intents`. Reproduction: 1) register B2C via /api/cloud/auth/register, 2) GET /api/auth/me → no account_type field, 3) browser → /it/cloud/account/sell → redirected to /register.
